_help: Add events and presentations here; the page sorts them by date. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" to always show the visitor's current date. Every field except date and title can be left out. kind: conference, meetup, online, workshop or talk. A presentation can name its slide pictures with 'images' (a folder and a count: folder/slide-01.jpg …), so it can be paged through on the page, and its files with 'slides' (PDF) and 'pptx'. 'film' plays a video under it (presentations and videos): {"file": "folder/name.mp4", "poster": "folder/name.jpg", "title": "…"}. Videos go in 'videos', each with a 'film'.
